main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward excess return (vs coin mean 20-bar return) on active bars, non-overlapping, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; inconclusive otherwise or if fewer than 30 non-overlapping active blocks

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of 20-bar excess return on forecast level (active, non-overlapping)

decided_by: The t-statistic of the mean 20-bar excess return lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: The coin's mean 20-bar return is the mean of every bar's 20-bar forward return across all of that coin's windows (all bars, overlapping), and active blocks are bars with forecast > 0 on the grid 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with a complete 20-bar forward return inside the window; the t-statistic is mean / (sd / sqrt(n)) and the supporting slope is the OLS slope of excess return on forecast over those same blocks.
